title: PCGNet: Unifying Shared and Specific Information for Fashion Matching Recommendations
abstract: arXiv:2609.13339v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In fashion domain, recommending complementary clothing items that match selected pieces is a crucial cross-selling technique that improves customer satisfaction. Nevertheless, fashion matching presents significant challenges, as recommendations must not only align with individual user fashion preferences but also ensure compatibility between garments. These challenges are twofold. First, existing models often assume an overly simplified decoupled relationship between product compatibility and personalized user preferences, overlooking the natural complexity between the two. Second, existing data-driven approaches are not optimized for real-world fashion data, which is typically sparse and characterized by noisy interactions. To address these challenges, we propose Personalized Compatibility Graph Network, a multi-objective graph learning framework that organically unifies the modeling of product compatibility and personal preferences. translated_title: PCGNet：统一共享与特定信息用于时尚搭配推荐
translated_abstract: 在时尚领域，推荐与所选单品相匹配的互补服装是提升顾客满意度的关键交叉销售技术。然而，时尚搭配面临重大挑战，因为推荐不仅要符合用户的个人时尚偏好，还必须确保服装之间的兼容性。这些挑战体现在两个方面：首先，现有模型通常假设产品兼容性与个性化用户偏好之间存在过于简化的解耦关系，忽视了两者之间天然的复杂性；其次，现有的数据驱动方法并未针对真实世界的时尚数据进行优化，而这些数据通常较为稀疏且包含大量噪声交互。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了个性化兼容性图网络（PCGNet），这是一个多目标图学习框架，能够有机地统一产品兼容性与个人偏好的建模。
tldr: 提出个性化兼容性图网络PCGNet，通过多目标图学习框架有机统一产品兼容性与用户个性化偏好的建模，从而在稀疏且含噪的真实时尚数据上实现更精准的搭配推荐。
en_tdlr: Proposes PCGNet, a multi-objective graph learning framework that organically unifies the modeling of product compatibility and personalized user preferences, enabling more accurate fashion matching recommendations on sparse and noisy real-world data.
